captions.detailed: This 3D-printable part is a flat, T-shaped connector bracket designed for structural mounting. The horizontal top bar features rounded, semi-circular ends and contains three mounting holes: one in the center and one on each wing. A vertical rectangular extension drops down from the center of the top bar and contains a fourth mounting hole. On one side, the mounting holes are circular, while on the opposite side, they feature hexagonal counterbores to recess hex-head screws or nuts flush with the surface.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric T-shaped connector bracket for mounting bicycle rack accessories. The script should allow customization of the horizontal screw spacing, vertical screw spacing, material thickness, screw hole radius, and the dimensions of the hexagonal counterbores for flush mounting.
captions.factory: The code defines a T-shaped bracket using a `T` module and a helper `hex_head` module. The main body is constructed in a `difference` block by unioning a central horizontal cube, two rotated cylinders at the horizontal ends to round them off, and a vertical cube. Four mounting holes are subtracted using the `hex_head` module, which creates a composite shape consisting of a circular cylinder for the screw body and three rotated, intersecting cubes to form a hexagonal counterbore for the screw head.
